Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id matching the ChEMBL document ID for CHEMBL5104090, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the results sorted by molecule ChEMBL ID.
